english.title: Cause unnecessary obstruction by a motor vehicle / trailer within the Greater London area

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Road Vehicles Construction and Use Regulations 1986

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person in charge of a

(A)_[ motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[trailer,]_

caused it to stand on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), so as to cause an unnecessary obstruction of the road
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 103 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied
(iii) See also the Removal and Disposal of Vehicle Regulations 1986.

welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i reoliad 103 Rheoliadau Cerbydau Ffyrdd (Gwneuthuriad a Defnydd) 1986, Adran 42 Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988 ac Atodlen 2 Deddf Troseddwyr Traffig Ffyrdd 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Forty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level four on the legislative standard scale
